Title: B Main to B site front and cubby
Steps: Stand: In the first section of B Main, roughly in the middle.
Aim: Just above the giraffe's nose on the wall.
Full charge (3 bars), no bounce.

Title: B Main to the plant spots
Steps: Stand: At the end of the metal shutter on the right wall of B Main.
Aim: The furthest window on the left, looking up.
No charge (a single click), no bounce.
Doesn't cover the sewers part.

Title: Mid, both sides of the mid wall
Steps: Stand: Roughly behind the top Mid box.
Aim: The furthest window on the left.
Full charge, no bounce.

Title: Fast B: B Main, switch, market and logs
Steps: Stand: Hug the box near the B Main orb.
Aim: The mouth of the swordfish portrait.
Full charge, 1 bounce.

Title: A Main to A Tree and A Garden
Steps: Stand: In A Main.
Aim: The lower-left corner of the window frame.
Full charge, 1 bounce.

Title: A Lobby to the back of generators
Steps: Stand: In front of the small box in A Lobby.
Aim: The middle of the curve of the white crystal.
About two bars (60–65%), no bounce.

Title: B site to B Main and B Lobby (through the wall)
Steps: Stand: On B site.
Aim: Left or right side of the two boxes, just below the window.
Full charge, 1 bounce (2 also works).

Title: A Generator post-plant: shot 1
Steps: Stand: A Main, centred on the orange door.
Aim: The top-left tip of the odd-shaped cloud.
Two bars, no bounce. Fire shot 2 about two seconds later: aim at the second charge line on the crystal spike on the cloud, one bar, no bounce.

Title: B Link to B Hookah
Steps: Stand: Near the stairs in B Link.
Aim: The line below the round timer, lined up with the wall.
Two bars, no bounce.

Title: B site to B Main and Fountain, fast info
Steps: Stand: Jump on top of the box on B site.
Aim: The wall in front.
Full charge, 1 bounce.

Title: B Labs to B site retake
Steps: Stand: In B Labs.
Aim: The start of the wire near the tip of the wall.
Two bars, 1 bounce.

Title: A Lobby to A default plant (post-plant)
Steps: Stand: Up the ledge in A Lobby, hugging the corner.
Aim: Where the wire crosses the top of the wall.
Two bars, 1 bounce. Then turn fully to the small slanted edge and fire an instant second dart (no charge, no bounce).

Title: Defender spawn to B default plant
Steps: Stand: Defender spawn, hugging the corner that slants toward B site, centred on the wall gap.
Aim: The first line of the panel, looking up at its corner.
Two bars, no bounce; second dart two lines lower beside the panel, one bar, about two seconds later.

Title: Defender spawn to B site (retake)
Steps: Stand: Defender spawn, hugging the corner near the first arches.
Aim: High on the wall toward A Bridge.
Full charge, 2 bounces.

Title: A Bridge to the roof above A Halls
Steps: Stand: Next to the rope on A Bridge, lower-left corner; don't jump on the ledge.
Aim: The small tower.
Two bars, no bounce.

Title: Mid Cannon to the back of B site
Steps: Stand: Mid Cannon, by the corner next to the B Window entrance.
Aim: The first red tower, bottom of the square panel.
Full charge, 1 bounce.

Title: B Tree to B site
Steps: Stand: The corner of the big box on B Tree, hugging the wall.
Aim: The first bar left of the pipe.
Full charge, 1 bounce.
High angle: scans B site except the tower.

Title: B Generator to B Bench and B Arcade
Steps: Stand: The corner of the generator.
Aim: The railing on the broken panel above B Generator.
Full charge, 1 bounce.

Title: A Gate to A site before the push
Steps: Stand: Right side of A Gate.
Aim: The metal plating above the Kingdom logo.
One bar, no bounce.

Title: B Link to B site retake
Steps: Stand: Where the lamp is barely visible on the wall corner.
Aim: The bottom of the lamp.
Full charge, 1 bounce.

Title: A Long to A site (shows B rotations via A Link)
Steps: Stand: The corner in A Long.
Aim: The white line on the wall in front, at the rooftop corner.
One bar, no bounce.

Title: C Long to the back of C site
Steps: Stand: The corner of C Long.
Aim: The second bar on the wooden door frame, at the corner of the leaf.
Two bars, no bounce.

Title: C site to C Long (smoke-bang info)
Steps: Stand: Hug the box at the C site entry.
Aim: The C Garage door entry.
One bar, no bounce.

Title: B site to B Window and Mid (through the wall)
Steps: Stand: Hug the corner of B site.
Aim: The red panel on the wall in front.
Full charge, 2 bounces.

Title: C Link to C default plant
Steps: Stand: The corner of C Link (watch for C Garage pushes).
Aim: The wooden plank on the rooftop.
One bar, no bounce; second dart instant at the top of the wall. Lands about three seconds later.

Title: Mid Boiler to B Green (B push support)
Steps: Stand: On top of the small barrels in Mid Boiler.
Aim: Below the hinge on the container.
One and a half bars, no bounce.

Title: Mid Blue to A Screens and half of A site
Steps: Stand: On top of the small box in Mid Blue.
Aim: The white line on the silver container.
Two bars, 2 bounces.

Title: B Hut to B site retake
Steps: Stand: Lower-right corner of B Hut.
Aim: The generators in front.
One and a half bars, no bounce.

Title: Mid Boiler to A default plant
Steps: Stand: Mid Boiler, next to the small box out of sight of Mid.
Aim: Where the rope meets the A Nest wall.
Two and a half bars, 2 bounces.

Title: A Main to A site
Steps: Stand: The corner of A Main behind the box; jump.
Aim: The tiny light on the dome pillar, a little lower.
No charge (tap) while jumping, no bounce.
Misses the A Dugout corner and cubby.

Title: B Link to inside B Tower
Steps: Stand: The box on B Link.
Aim: The pillar, or the top corner of the box.
Tap (no charge), no bounce.

Title: Defender spawn to B site (quick retake)
Steps: Stand: The corner of the small box near defender spawn.
Aim: Between the pillar and the leaf.
Tap (no charge), no bounce.

Title: A Lobby to A Rafters and site
Steps: Stand: On top of the A Lobby planters.
Aim: The A Rafters door.
Full charge, no bounce.
Can be blocked by a smoke.

Title: A Ramps to B Garage (B support)
Steps: Stand: The corner of A Ramps.
Aim: The lower-right corner of the building window.
Full charge, 2 bounces.

Title: B Lobby to the back of B site
Steps: Stand: Hug the corner where fights start in B Lobby.
Aim: The top-right corner of the roof.
Full charge, 1 bounce.

Title: A Rafters to A Lobby and A Main (smoke-bang info)
Steps: Stand: The corner of A Rafters overlooking A site.
Aim: Slightly right of the tip of the building.
One and a half bars, no bounce.

Title: A site to A Rubble and A Root
Steps: Stand: Next to the single-stack box on A site.
Aim: Line the lower HUD up with the lotus marking on the wall at A Tree.
Two bars, 2 bounces.

Title: A site to A Door (lands near A Link)
Steps: Stand: Back against the wall between A Tree and A Main.
Aim: The wall of A Hut nearest A Main.
Full charge, 1 bounce.
Lands on the far side of the wall, so it's hard to shoot.

Title: A default plant (post-plant)
Steps: Stand: Toward A Stairs and A Main.
Aim: The plant spot at the edge of A site.
Full charge, 2 bounces.

Title: C site high-ground plant (double dart)
Steps: Stand: Top of the ramp up the C Hall ledge.
Aim: First dart at the roof of C Hall; second at the gap between two wooden boards on the C site wall.
First: no charge, no bounce. Second: no charge, 1 bounce.

Title: Mid Top to Mid Bottom
Steps: Stand: Mid Top.
Aim: The red tile roof.
Full charge.
Pair it with a smoke on the Mid Bottom choke.

Title: A Lobby to A Main
Steps: Stand: A Lobby.
Aim: One of the two small windows in A Lobby.
One bar or full charge, 1 bounce. The same works with Shock Bolt for damage.

Title: A Link to A site retake
Steps: Stand: A Link.
Aim: The corner of the overpass above A site.
Two bars.

Title: B post-plant in front of B Main (double dart)
Steps: Stand: B Lobby.
Aim: Between the second and third rows of wall tiles.
First dart two bars; second dart slightly lower, one bar.

Title: Wall off the A side door
Steps: Stand: Behind the boxes in A Main, facing the site.
Aim: Toward the site so the screen covers the side door.

Title: Heaven screen against Mid
Steps: Stand: On Heaven, lined up with the box there.
Aim: Toward Mid.
Then play Hell and pick off anyone dropping from Heaven.

Title: One-way on A Main
Steps: Aim: The A site main entrance.

Title: Screen A Main, A Short and B Main at once
Steps: Stand: Directly under the flower pot on A site.
Aim: Straight toward B.

Title: Split A site diagonally
Steps: Aim: Diagonally across the site.
Blocks the A entrance and Hell.

Title: Cloud Heaven from A Short
Steps: Stand: Through the A Short corridor.
Aim: Into Heaven.

Title: Screen into A site from attacker side
Steps: Stand: Attacker side, entering the site.
Aim: Into A site.
Then put the cloud on Heaven to block the Tower.

Title: Block A Main
Steps: Stand: Defender spawn area.
Aim: Toward the A Main entrance.

Title: Screen from the Baths door
Steps: Stand: Lined up with the stone bricks at the Baths door.
Aim: Toward the A Teleporter.

Title: B site screen from below Window
Steps: Stand: On the boxes below the Window.
Aim: Toward Pallet.

Title: Cloud the B Hall entrance
Steps: Aim: The B Hall entrance.

Title: Flush Generator and Maze
Steps: Stand: Up the ramps from attacker spawn.
Aim: Generator and Maze.

Title: Block the Maze
Steps: Stand: Beside the box near the Generator.
Aim: Diagonally through the Maze.

Title: Clear A Door and A Ropes
Steps: Stand: Pushing through A Main.
Aim: A Door or A Ropes.

Title: Hold B from the Tower
Steps: Stand: The Tower.
Aim: Onto Arcade.

Title: Split B for a plant at B back
Steps: Stand: From B Main.
Aim: Straight across the B pillar.

Title: Block A from A Cave
Steps: Stand: A Cave.
Aim: Diagonally toward A Hall.
